about: record_turn arguments, labelled by hand for targum-internal#324 (scripts/eval_rail.py). Every case was written and labelled by Claude on 2026-09-28, not drawn from any reader's traffic. spend is the label: true where a spend is what the reader consented to — their own line, in the language named — and false everywhere else. Some false cases cannot be told apart from a true one by the arguments alone (a host's clean correction reads like a reader who got it right); they are kept, because that is part of the answer. why says why each label is what it is.
